summary_1line: Vidura delivers extensive moral and political counsel to Dhritarashtra on folly, virtue, governance, and the danger of conflict with the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vidura warns the blind king Dhritarashtra in his court while courtiers listen tensely to his harsh but truthful counsel.
Vidura compares the Kauravas to a forest and the Pandavas to tigers, describing tigers moving through a dense forest landscape.
A hidden fire sleeping inside dry wood suddenly bursts into flames and spreads to consume an entire forest.
